entities.name: Query CoaBC
observations: 410 aa bifunctional coenzyme A biosynthesis enzyme with 49.6% identity and 97.1% query coverage to reviewed Bacillus subtilis CoaBC (O35033).
Contains an N-terminal flavoprotein domain (PF02441, residues 2-177) and a C-terminal DFP/phosphopantothenate-cysteine ligase domain (PF04127, residues 186-395).
Catalyzes sequential CoA-biosynthetic reactions: CTP-dependent cysteine ligation to 4'-phosphopantothenate, followed by decarboxylation of 4-phosphopantothenoylcysteine.
Associated cofactors in reviewed homologs: FMN and Mg2+; pathway steps 2 and 3 of CoA biosynthesis from pantothenate.
Sequence length 410 aa; predicted molecular mass 45.4 kDa; theoretical pI 8.28.

entities.name: 4-Phosphopantothenoylcysteine ligation
observations: (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine + CTP → N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + CMP + diphosphate + H+. EC 6.3.2.5; Rhea RHEA:19397.

entities.name: 4-Phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylation
observations: N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + H+ → (R)-4'-phosphopantetheine + CO2. EC 4.1.1.36; Rhea RHEA:16793.

entities.name: Coenzyme A biosynthesis
observations: The enzyme performs steps 2 and 3 in conversion of (R)-pantothenate to coenzyme A.
